item.title: Debt collectors now calling randomly
item.description: Debt collectors, whose work has been publicised by television, admit targeting non-debtors. A debt collector working for one debt recovery company told us, 'We don't bother trying to get the address right. It's always wrong on the paperwork anyway. So we just pick any old address in the area and turn up on spec. 'Usually people open the front door and I put me foot in, and they can't close it.
